releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.48 merges Inbox into Library without removing or adding Inbox functionality. Library and Inbox now share one root tab with a simple internal switch, while all existing Inbox actions and all Library features remain unchanged. The standalone Inbox bottom-navigation tab is removed, leaving Home, Files, Notes and Library as the four current root tabs. Instagram fetching, Smart Life saving, automatic Gallery saving and manual Save to Gallery from v0.11.47 are preserved.
